test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In association with whom did the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB) launch the 'Fund for Industrial Research Engagement (FIRE)' in June 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **Intel India.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__****Intel India**

__
 
• **​​Intel Corporation, commonly known as Intel, is an American multinational corporation and technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California**.
 
• **It is the world's largest semiconductor chip manufacturer by revenue.** 
 
• It is one of the **developer of the x86 series of instruction sets, the instruction sets found in most personal computers**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​​Research initiative called ‘Fund for Industrial Research Engagement (FIRE)’ launched by the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), a statutory body of Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India.**
 
• It will help to promote research in the upcoming critical areas of science and engineering with Public-Private Partnerships.
 
• It will offer researchers a platform to perform industry-related opportunities in the areas like Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), platform systems, circuits & architecture, Internet of Things (IoT), materials & devices, security, and edge to cloud.
